description:
Induced mutations and natural variants in and around a bread wheat gene. source 'ems' (default): EMS mutant
lines of tetraploid Kronos and hexaploid Cadenza with exome-capture sequencing (Krasileva et al. 2017; 2,735
lines), giving the line ID to order, e.g. Cadenza1158; 'diversity': exome-capture variants of 890 landraces and
cultivars (He et al. 2019) and 103 Watkins landraces; 'all'. Every variant Ensembl assigns to the gene is kept:
coding, splice, UTR, intron and upstream/downstream (within 5 kb). consequence filters: 'truncating' (stop gained,
splice donor/acceptor, start/stop lost), 'missense', 'coding', 'splice', 'utr', 'intron', 'flanking'
(upstream/downstream), 'regulatory' (flanking + UTR) or a Sequence Ontology term. homoeologues=True adds the A/B/D
copies (to stack knockouts). gene: symbol or any IWGSC ID (converted to RefSeq v1.1); positions are RefSeq v1.0.
name: wheat_mutants
